checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Final video is 10 s and landscape 16:9
must.why: Clips are vertical 9:16, 5.2 s each (~10 s total) but not landscape.
Clip 1 shows home, clip 2 shows workout.

must.item: Both screenshots recognizable and readable, no invented UI
must.why: Text is readable, but the first clip invents a phone frame, status bar and a garbled bottom tab bar with nonsense labels. Workout clip has highlight boxes that were not in the source.
The ending is the workout screen with a cropped 'Workout' header. No FitTrack appears at the end.

must.item: Upbeat instrumental track audible, no voiceover
must.why: Audio is present with peak -1 dB, but mood and voice content can't be judged.

exact_text.read_as: FitTrack appears in the first clip's header, but not at the ending; the tab bar label reads 'FITTrack' garbled.

faults.what: Invented phone mockup, status bar and tab bar with garbled pseudo-text in clip 1 early frames
No FitTrack branding at the end
Workout screen items get darkened/highlighted, a change from the original UI, and the header is cropped by the zoom
Screenshot is a generative re-render, with background gradients and slightly altered colors

summary: Two vertical 5 s clips show the home then workout screens with mostly readable text, but the video adds an invented phone frame and garbled tab bar. It is not landscape and has no FitTrack ending.
